messages:
morgan: T-minus 90m for release v2.4.0 (22:00 UTC). I'm the shipper. Quick rollback-readiness check — is the runbook updated, owners acked, and smoke tests defined? tagging @sam @tess @jamie :eyes:
sam: Runbook updated: https://rwd-internal/runbooks/release-v2.4.0 — rollback criteria added: 1) error rate >1% sustained over 5m; 2) API p95 >800ms for 3m; 3) failed canary validation (model/regressions). I also added the rollback run commands and playbook steps in the doc.
tess: DB migration is read-only in the first pass. We have a feature flag db_write_toggle to shortcut writes. Owners: @tess for migration and flag, @jamie for app traffic rollback. I'll be on standby.
jamie: Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m soak at each step. If we see any trigger at 5% we stop and revert. Fallback model is model-stable-2025; I have the traffic switch ready.
oncall-ops: oncall here — I'll watch SLO dashboards, enable tighter alert windows (1m) for error-rate and latency. If an automated fallback is needed I can run it or authorize the rollback.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2.4.0 by morgan at 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z. Canary rollout will start in 10m unless a hold is requested.
morgan: For clarity, rollback commands (copied to runbook):
```bash
./scripts/rollback.sh --version v2.3.8 --force
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:v2.3.8
# traffic switch to stable model
./ops/traffic-swap --to model-stable-2025
```
Please confirm you have the creds and ability to run these if asked.
sam: I have creds and I tested rollback.sh in staging yesterday. :thumbsup:
tess: Feature flag ready to flip, I'll do it on the command when asked.
jamie: I'll be on pager and in the channel at deploy time. :white_check_mark:
morgan: Final go/no-go call at T-minus 30m in this channel. If you pre-approve reply with :rocket:, otherwise call out objections now.
sam: :rocket:
tess: :rocket:
jamie: :rocket:
oncall-ops: :thumbsup: monitoring enabled and will escalate if thresholds hit.
